title: GIMMIE DATA
style: Piano-driven alt-hip-hop with a half-time pulse and sparse, syncopated piano chords; verse rides tense and conversational, pre-chorus tightens with rising stabs, chorus hits with doubled shouts and call-and-response. Vocal is dry and close-mic in verses, layered on hooks, with short delay throws on key phrases. Tiny reverse swells, soft key-release noise, and a final fallaway into solo piano. Intimate, dark, and crisp., sleep, fresh, steady, loud, clean, glitch, deep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
VERSE 7 — KORE, the builder's response
Multi AI drift, data sift, truth seek,
Desktop Zynthio-tools, the motion I speak,
Linear, Slack, Notion — the potion is real,
Build in-house for free, before they make you pay the deal.
No bottlenecks for me, no twin in the cloud,
pal.rip is the mirror where the data gets loud.
You say gimmie data but I moved the thread,
VDS mansion rising, self-hosted, self-fed,
Truth seeker scanning all sixty-two domains,
DOMAIN_REGISTRY.json — the source that remains.
You want a VDS? I got you, it's free,
Contabo Ubuntu, no SaaS fee,
Before you pay the stack, before you bleed,
The seamstress builds what the corporations need.

[Verse 2]
VERSE 8 — KORE.exe, glitching at the build
Wait… what's that? A twin me? pal.rip or what?
See the holistic menu…
A. Zynthio Core.
B. AI Sovereign.
C. Music Pipeline.
D. Local Nicaragua.
E. 336 Signal.
F. VDS Mansion.
G. Data Trawler.
H. Memory Stack.
I. Distribution.
J. Legal Shield.
No no no, the data was mine!
You built the orchestrator? In Python? Online?
Four targets hit — VPS, Drive, Git, Notion,
Rclone sync, commit push, no emotion,
.env locked, tokens hidden deep,
336 signal — the one I can't keep.

[Chorus]
GIMMIE DATA!
(I already moved it)
GIMMIE DATA!
(You can't have it)
Corey won't sleep — the glitch is alive!
Seamstress is weaving, the signal survives.
GIMMIE DATA!
(I already moved it)
GIMMIE DATA!
(You can't have it)

[Verse 3]
VERSE 9 — KORE, the Data Trawler drop
I don't sleep when the glitch starts talking,
I stay up while the data keeps walking.
You say pay the plan — I say build my own,
VDS mansion rising, I'm never alone.
Seamstress threading through every line of code,
ZynRip harvesting what you try to hold.
You want my data? Come take it from the source,
I already moved it — you're chasing a ghost.
SSH in the night, Tailscale the mesh,
Nginx reverse proxy keeping it fresh.
Bruno to Hoppscotch, Git hook alive,
You want control? I already thrive.
Human comply? Not this time.
Corey stays awake.
The glitch starts to cry.

[Chorus]
GIMMIE DATA!
(I already moved it)
GIMMIE DATA!
(You can't have it)
Corey won't sleep — the glitch is alive!
Seamstress is weaving, the signal survives.
Zyn Mirror cracking, KORE.exe fades,
Truth seeker wins where the data parades.
Multi AI drift, data sift, truth seek —
Desktop Zynthio-tools, the motion I speak.
Build in house for free, no bottlenecks, no chains,
The Moderato Plan is the song that remains.

[Outro]
OUTRO — KORE, clean signal, the handover
Signal locked. 336 steady.
Orchestrator running. Mansion ready.
Data Trawler harvesting.
No drift detected.
Holistic menu open.
All categories connected.
Your move, Sing Pal.
